dialogues.speaker: Idhari
dialogues.text: If someone can find an answer, that person is definitely me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: An answer to what?

dialogues.speaker: Idhari
dialogues.text: The biggest problem before me, the answer I seek is... Yes, it is The Withering.

dialogues.speaker: Idhari
dialogues.text: The issue of The Withering has been growing in severity lately, and it's spreading even more rapidly and further now.

dialogues.speaker: Idhari
dialogues.text: There aren't many who have Visions, so relying on them to resolve it won't really work.

dialogues.speaker: Idhari
dialogues.text: So, it's my time to shine. It's my time to eliminate The Withering from its source!

dialogues.speaker: Idhari
dialogues.text: Hehe, my reputation in the Akademiya will definitely rise once I've resolved such a major problem, and I may even get to be a sage!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Idhari
dialogues.text: Just wait and see! I'll definitely succeed.

dialogues.speaker: Idhari
dialogues.text: New topic... a new topic... *sigh* Agh, come on!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you mean "new topic"?

dialogues.speaker: Idhari
dialogues.text: Do you know what we researchers fear the most?

dialogues.speaker: Idhari
dialogues.text: We fear the loss of research direction, that's what!

dialogues.speaker: Idhari
dialogues.text: Perhaps my luck is just terrible, but there is presently no need to pursue the topic that I was originally looking into.

dialogues.speaker: Idhari
dialogues.text: And here I was looking to make a name for myself by solving a major problem... and would you look at that? It's all come to nothing!

dialogues.speaker: Idhari
dialogues.text: This should be a time of opportunity! Four out of our six sage seats are empty! And here I am...

dialogues.speaker: Idhari
dialogues.text: No. No, I can't give up just yet. They're not just going to flip a coin and pick a sage just like that!

dialogues.speaker: Idhari
dialogues.text: As long as I can find a research topic more important and with more potential than the last, I've still got a chance...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Idhari
dialogues.text: Yes. I'm not going to give up now!
